heading: Important information about GB Mortgages
intro: You're entitled to know how we work and how we're paid before you decide to use our services. If anything isn't clear, ask us.
seo_description: GB Mortgages public disclosure statement: our licence, the advice we give, the lenders we may recommend, our fees and commissions, conflicts of interest and how to make a complaint.

sections.title: About GB Mortgages
sections.body:
GB Mortgages Limited (trading as GB Mortgages) holds a Financial Advice Provider licence issued by the Financial Markets Authority to provide financial advice services. Our Financial Service Provider (FSP) number is FSP1013399. Our financial adviser is Philippa Impey (FSP1013396).

**Our office contact details**

* Address: 45 Bay View Road, Kelvin Heights, Queenstown 9300
* Phone: 027 424 5544
* Email: philly@gbmortgages.co.nz
* Website: www.gbmortgages.co.nz

sections.title: Nature and scope of our financial advice services
sections.body:
**Our services**

Mortgage and lending advice (debt management), including borrowing for:

- your home
- property investment
- business and commercial purposes

**Products we can give advice about**

- Home loans: purchase, refinance, top-up, construction, refix and restructure, and bridging finance
- Investment property loans
- Business and commercial lending: commercial property, working capital, business purchase, development finance and asset finance
- Personal lending, including personal loans and vehicle finance

We do not give advice on insurance, investments (including KiwiSaver), tax, or legal matters. If you need advice in these areas, we can suggest a suitable specialist.

sections.title: Our fees
sections.body:
For most home and investment property loans we do not charge a fee, because the lender pays us a commission when your loan settles.

We may charge you a one-off fee in these situations:

- **When we do not receive commission from the lender.** This can happen with some business, commercial and non-bank lenders, or if you ask us to arrange a product outside our usual arrangements with our lenders. Any fee will be based on an estimate of the time spent providing the advice, and agreed with you in writing before we complete the work.
- **When we have to repay commission to the lender.** If, within 28 months of your loan being drawn down, it is fully or partly repaid or its terms are materially changed, and the lender requires us to repay our commission, we may charge you a one-off fee. The fee will be no more than $2,500, calculated at $250 an hour for the time we spent providing advice on that loan, and will never be more than the commission we have to repay.

For business and commercial lending, any fee is set out in a letter of engagement before we start. If a lender also pays us commission, we will tell you and reduce the fee by that amount.

You will be invoiced for any one-off fee and given 7 days to pay. We are not GST registered, so no GST is added.

sections.title: Other costs
sections.body: Costs charged by others, such as lender fees, valuations and legal fees, are payable by you to those parties. We will tell you about any we know of before you proceed.

sections.title: Commissions
sections.body:
When your loan settles, the lender pays us a commission. The lender pays this; it is not added to your loan. We keep the full commission; none of it is shared with our aggregator, Kiwi Adviser Network. Instead we pay KAN a fixed monthly fee for compliance support, systems and lender access, which does not change with the lender we recommend or the number of loans we arrange.

- **Initial commission:** a one-off payment of between 0.55% and 0.90% of the amount borrowed, depending on the lender.
- **Ongoing commission:** some lenders pay an ongoing (trail) commission of between 0.15% and 0.20% a year of the outstanding loan balance. Not all lenders pay ongoing commission.

We will tell you the exact commission for your loan before you decide to proceed.

sections.title: Conflicts of interest or other incentives
sections.body:
Commission rates differ between lenders and loan types, which could be seen as creating an incentive to recommend one lender over another. We do not have volume targets or sales incentives with any lender. Our adviser previously worked at ASB and BNZ; she has no ongoing financial interest in either bank, and we recommend lenders based on your needs.

Occasionally we refer clients to trusted partners, such as insurance advisers, lawyers, accountants and personal finance companies. Most of these arrangements involve no payment, but in some cases we may receive a referral fee. If so, we will tell you before you proceed.

sections.title: How we manage any conflicts of interest
sections.body:
To make sure your interests come first:

- We follow a set advice process, and record why the lending we recommend suits your goals and circumstances.
- Our adviser completes ongoing training, including on managing conflicts of interest.
- We keep registers of conflicts of interest and of gifts and incentives, and review them at least quarterly.
- Our advice files are reviewed independently by Kiwi Adviser Network at least every six months.

sections.title: Our duties and obligations to you
sections.body:
GB Mortgages, and anyone who gives financial advice on our behalf, has duties under the Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013 (sections 431I, 431K, 431L and 431M). We must:

- meet the standards of competence, knowledge and skill in the Code of Professional Conduct for Financial Advice Services
- give priority to your interests
- exercise care, diligence and skill
- meet the standards of ethical behaviour, conduct and client care in the Code.

More information is available from the FMA at www.fma.govt.nz.

sections.title: Our internal complaints process
sections.body:
If you have a problem, concern, or complaint about any part of our advice or service, please tell us so that we can try to fix the problem.

Our internal complaints manager is Philippa Impey, who can be reached at hello@gbmortgages.co.nz or 027 424 5544.

Our internal complaints handling process is as follows:

1. Tell us about your complaint by email, phone or in writing, or use our [online complaint form](https://gbmortgages.gettrail.com/base/complaint?Id=1187-17813).
2. We will acknowledge your complaint in writing within 24 hours, let you know who is handling it, and give you the contact details for our external dispute resolution scheme, Financial Services Complaints Limited ("FSCL").
3. We will look into it, may ask you for more information, and aim to resolve it within 7 working days. If we need longer, we will tell you why and keep you updated.
4. If you are not happy with our response, you can contact our external dispute resolution scheme (below).

sections.title: Our external complaints process
sections.body:
If we cannot resolve your complaint, or you would rather not use our internal process, you can contact our external dispute resolution scheme, FSCL. This service costs you nothing and is independent of us.

Our FSCL membership number is 9784.

You can contact FSCL at:

- Address: PO Box 5967, Wellington 6140
- Phone: 0800 347 257
- Email: complaints@fscl.org.nz
- Website: www.fscl.org.nz

sections.title: Professional indemnity insurance
sections.body: GB Mortgages Limited holds professional indemnity insurance, as required by our aggregator and lender agreements.

sections.title: Reliability history
sections.body: Neither GB Mortgages Limited nor Philippa Impey has been subject to a reliability event (for example, legal proceedings or insolvency) that might materially influence your decision to use our services.
